en.name: Exorcist
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.

zh.name: 驱魔人
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家（与上个夜晚不同）：如果你选中了恶魔，他会得知你的角色，但他当晚不会因其自身能力而被唤醒。
